name: osat
description: OSAT — a calm, private layer over your Mac
author: Nate McCreery

scripts.start:mac: node scripts/build-listen.mjs && npm run build:helpers && npm run build && electron .
scripts.dist:mac: node scripts/build-listen.mjs && npm run build:helpers && npm run build && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --arm64
scripts.test:ui: node tests/ui/smoke.mjs && node tests/ui/auto-file.mjs && node tests/ui/kept.mjs && node tests/ui/ask.mjs && node tests/ui/overnight.mjs && node tests/ui/github.mjs && node tests/ui/mail.mjs && node tests/ui/passwords.mjs && node tests/ui/meetings.mjs && node tests/ui/boards.mjs && node tests/ui/habits.mjs && node tests/ui/whats-new.mjs && node tests/ui/just-in.mjs && node tests/ui/connections.mjs

extendInfo.NSAppleEventsUsageDescription: OSAT shows what is playing in Spotify and lets you play, pause and skip. If the Bin won’t let OSAT read it, Undo asks Finder to put a file back. To paste something you copied into the app you were in, and to move windows to a half or a corner, it asks System Events to press ⌘V and to move the front window. When you ask from the quick bar, it turns dark mode on or off, hides other apps, locks the screen and asks Finder to empty the Bin. In the Mail room it asks the Mail app to show your inbox, open a message and start a reply for you to look over; it never sends anything.
extendInfo.NSDesktopFolderUsageDescription: OSAT shows the files on your Desktop, so you can open them or ask about them without leaving it.
extendInfo.NSDocumentsFolderUsageDescription: OSAT shows your Documents folder when you open it in Files, and finds files there from ⌘K.
extendInfo.NSDownloadsFolderUsageDescription: OSAT shows your Downloads folder when you open it in Files, and finds files there from ⌘K.
extendInfo.NSCalendarsFullAccessUsageDescription: OSAT shows your Mac's calendar events beside its own and lets you add an event to a calendar you choose.
extendInfo.NSCalendarsUsageDescription: OSAT shows your Mac's calendar events beside its own and lets you add an event to a calendar you choose.
extendInfo.NSRemindersFullAccessUsageDescription: OSAT shows your Mac's reminders that are due soon and lets you add or complete a reminder.
extendInfo.NSRemindersUsageDescription: OSAT shows your Mac's reminders that are due soon and lets you add or complete a reminder.
extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: OSAT listens through your microphone only while you are recording a meeting, and writes it up on this Mac. The sound is deleted once it is written up, and it never leaves your Mac.
